name: constructorWithNullDataset
expected: Successfully initializes MultiplePiePlot with a null dataset, default table order BY_COLUMN, limit 0.0, and a sub-pie chart with a bottom title.

name: constructorWithValidDataset
input: dataset = DefaultCategoryDataset with sample rows and columns
expected: Successfully initializes MultiplePiePlot, registers dataset listener, sets group, and fires dataset change event.

name: getDatasetReturnsAssignedDataset
input: MultiplePiePlot initialized with a non-null CategoryDataset
expected: Returns the exact CategoryDataset instance that was passed to the constructor/setDataset.

name: getDatasetReturnsNullWhenUnassigned
expected: Returns null as no dataset is present.

name: getPieChartReturnsNonNullJFreeChart
expected: Returns a non-null JFreeChart instance configured with a PiePlot, no legend, and a default bottom title.

name: setPieChartUpdatesChartInstance
input: New JFreeChart instance with a PiePlot
expected: Successfully replaces the internal pie chart and updates successfully via getter.

name: getDataExtractOrderDefaultValue
expected: Returns TableOrder.BY_COLUMN by default as specified in the constructor.

name: setDataExtractOrderUpdatesOrder
expected: Successfully updates data extract order to BY_ROW.

name: setLimitUpdatesDoubleValue
expected: Successfully updates the limit property to 0.05.

name: getAggregatedItemsKeyDefaultValue
expected: Returns 'Other' as the default aggregated items key.

name: setAggregatedItemsKeyUpdatesKey
expected: Successfully updates the aggregated items key to 'Rest'.

name: getAggregatedItemsPaintDefaultValue
expected: Returns Color.lightGray as the default aggregated items paint.

name: setAggregatedItemsPaintUpdatesPaint
expected: Successfully updates the aggregated items paint to Color.DARK_GRAY.

name: getPlotTypeReturnsExpectedString
expected: Returns a non-null string representing the plot type identifier.

name: equalsWithSameInstance
expected: Returns true because an object is equal to itself.

name: equalsWithNullObject
expected: Returns false because an object cannot be equal to null.
